subject: Exec recap: Redwood + AuroraMed — business outcomes, procurement path, next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Samuel Voss <sam.voss@auroramed.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@auroramed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 1:10 PM PDT
Subject: Exec recap: Redwood + AuroraMed — business outcomes, procurement path, next steps

Hi Sam / Elena —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick executive-level recap from our discussion and the recommended next steps so your procurement and legal teams have context. Please let me know if I missed anything or if you want this spun into a one-page for the board.

Summary of pain points we heard
- Search & triage latency on historical EHR notes (clinicians wait 20–30s / query) — impacts throughput and increases length of stay.
- High per-token inference cost for nightly aggregation jobs (current model infra costs growing 3x YoY).
- PHI handling and region-specific residency concerns for EU patient data.
- Fragmented summarization: clinical teams do manual extraction, leading to inconsistency and increased QA cycles.

Business outcomes AuroraMed is targeting
- Reduce clinician query latency to <3s for common triage queries (goal: 50% reduction in time-to-action).
- Cut inference costs for nightly batch jobs by >40% through batching/quantization and caching.
- Deploy a compliant, auditable pipeline for PHI with KMS-backed keys and per-request audit logs.
- Ship structured discharge summaries to reduce manual QA by 60% in Q3.

Risk & escalation items
- SOC2 evidence + security questionnaire: AuroraMed will need our recent SOC2 report, pen-test summary, and architecture diagram.
- EU data residency: we recommended our EU-region private deployment for EU patient data and a hybrid routing policy.
- SLA / uptime: they asked about 99.9% SLA and credits; flagged as procurement negotiation item.

Procurement path / timeline (as discussed)
- Procurement will run internal vendor review + PO issuance. Sam indicated legal will need a redline of our MSA and the standard FedRAMP-style security addendum.
- Target dates suggested on call: procurement kickoff week of May 3; PO signed by May 20 if review goes smoothly.

Immediate next steps (action owners)
- Marissa (me): prepare a 1-pager exec brief and attach SOC2 + pen-test artifacts — attached. (Deliverable: Exec_Summary_Redwood.pdf)
- Lauri (ops): schedule a technical deep-dive and SRE Q&A for May 4 with the AuroraMed infra team.
- Aditya: prepare a draft SOW and an example SLA language to start legal review (attached draft_SLA_terms.docx).
- AuroraMed: share legal contact and any mandatory contract clauses or procurement form fields.

Attachments included: Exec_Summary_Redwood.pdf, draft_SLA_terms.docx (SLA language + baseline SOW).

Thank you — I’ll follow up to lock the exec briefing time tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0138

----
Redwood Inference | production-first LLM serving for predictable latency & cost

From: Dr. Samuel Voss <sam.voss@auroramed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@auroramed.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 3:45 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Exec recap: Redwood + AuroraMed — business outcomes, procurement path, next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the concise recap — that matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement / legal: please send the standard MSA and any sample redlines. Our legal team is legal@auroramed.com. They will also need a breakdown of hosting options (hosted vs. private EU region) and estimated monthly costs for both.
- Security evidence: SOC2 + pen-test + architecture diagram are required — please include these in the packet (we saw the attachment list).
- Timeline: procurement aims to start vendor evaluation the week of May 3. We’d like to have a pricing proposal and SOW before that kickoff so we can move quickly.
- Data residency: EU patients will need routing to an EU-hosted gateway — please confirm Redwood supports this and whether it requires a private deployment.

I’ve looped in Elena (CIO) who will help drive the legal/vendor review and will schedule internal slots for the exec briefing.

Regards,
Sam
Dr. Samuel Voss
Chief Medical Officer, AuroraMed
sam.voss@auroramed.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Marissa / Aditya —

Looping in the two of you to coordinate the deliverables Sam requested. I’ve pulled the attachments into the shared folder and added an internal checklist (procurement_checklist.xlsx).

High-level owner list / timeline:
- Marissa: final exec one-pager & SOC2 artifacts — due Apr 23 EOD (I’ll help polish visuals).
- Aditya: SOW + pricing scenarios (hosted vs private EU region) — draft by Apr 27 so Legal has time for redlines pre-kickoff.
- Ops (I'll assign): technical deep-dive with AuroraMed infra team — propose May 4 10:00 AM PT.
- Legal: prepare MSA redline template (we’ll push to DocuSign once AuroraMed confirms).

I added the HubSpot record and DocuSign pre-fill in the related links for the deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/auroramed and https://docusign.com/submit/RWI-2027-0452.

Escalation notes: if procurement requests EU data residency guarantees we should route to the Private deployment early — raising to Product for a formal quote.

Next steps for Marissa:
1) Send final exec one-pager + SOC2 bundle to Sam & Elena (cc: legal@auroramed.com).
2) Confirm exec briefing time (Elena proposed Apr 28 — confirm availability).
3) Aditya to share pricing scenarios by Apr 27.

Thanks — I’ll track these in the deal and set reminders.

Laura Bennett
